aaa_enabled.summary: Configure external RADIUS, LDAP, or Active Directory authentication for centralized administrator access.
cli: auth-server radius <NAME> <IP> <PORT>
UI_REMEDIATION: Fireware Web UI -> Authentication -> Servers -> Add External Server
aaa_enabled.notes: WatchGuard Fireware supports external authentication via RADIUS, LDAP, Active Directory, SecurID, and SAML. Configure centralized external authentication. Ref: Fireware Web UI / CLI Reference (auth-server).

secure_vty_transport.summary: Ensure unencrypted management is disabled and access is strictly via HTTPS (Web UI) and SSH.
cli: UI_REMEDIATION: Fireware Web UI -> Firewall -> Firewall Policies -> WatchGuard Web UI (HTTPS 4117/8080) and WatchGuard (SSH 4118)
secure_vty_transport.notes: WatchGuard Fireware does not support Telnet or cleartext HTTP management. Administration is strictly conducted over TLS/HTTPS (port 4117) and SSH (port 4118). Ref: Fireware Technical Documentation.

vty_idle_timeout.summary: Set administrator idle session timeout to 10 minutes (600 seconds) or less.
cli: idle-timeout 10
UI_REMEDIATION: Fireware Web UI -> System -> Global Settings -> System Parameters -> Set Idle Timeout to 10 minutes
vty_idle_timeout.notes: Configure administrator idle session timeout to terminate unattended sessions automatically within 600 seconds. Ref: Fireware Help Center (System Parameters).

enable_secret_encrypted.summary: Enforce strong password policy and ensure credentials are cryptographically protected at rest.
cli: password min-length 16
UI_REMEDIATION: Fireware Web UI -> System -> Users and Roles -> Password Policy -> Set Minimum Length >= 16
enable_secret_encrypted.notes: WatchGuard Fireware stores administrative passphrases cryptographically hashed by default. Set password length and complexity requirements. Ref: Fireware Help Center (Users and Roles).

no_default_snmp_community.summary: Remove well-known default SNMP community strings ('public' or 'private') and configure SNMPv3 or custom community.
cli: no snmp community public
snmp version v2c
snmp community <CUSTOM_NAME> ro
UI_REMEDIATION: Fireware Web UI -> System -> SNMP -> Remove 'public' and configure custom community or SNMPv3
no_default_snmp_community.notes: Default SNMP communities expose internal device metrics. Remove public/private and configure unique custom communities or SNMPv3. Ref: Fireware CLI Reference (snmp).

http_server_disabled.summary: Enforce HTTPS-only administration; unencrypted HTTP administration is unsupported on Fireware.
cli: UI_REMEDIATION: Fireware Web UI enforces HTTPS on port 4117/8080 by default
http_server_disabled.notes: WatchGuard Fireware does not provide an unencrypted HTTP administrative server. Management Web UI is HTTPS-only. Ref: Fireware Architecture Guide.

ssh_version_2.summary: Ensure SSH management service is active (Fireware SSH daemon exclusively enforces SSHv2).
cli: UI_REMEDIATION: Fireware Web UI -> Firewall Policies -> WatchGuard policy enabled on port 4118 (SSHv2)
ssh_version_2.notes: WatchGuard Fireware SSH service runs exclusively over SSHv2. Legacy SSHv1 is not supported. Ref: Fireware CLI Reference.

management_acl_applied.summary: Restrict administrative access (Web UI and SSH) to authorized management networks and trusted aliases.
cli: UI_REMEDIATION: Fireware Web UI -> Firewall Policies -> Edit 'WatchGuard Web UI' and 'WatchGuard' policies -> Set 'From' to 'Any-Trusted' or specific management IP addresses, remove 'Any-External'
management_acl_applied.notes: Management policies must never permit unrestricted access from Any-External or public IP addresses. Restrict source to trusted management subnets. Ref: WatchGuard Firebox Security Hardening Guide.

login_banner_configured.summary: Enable Logon Disclaimer to display authorized access warning banner prior to login.
cli: logon-disclaimer enable
logon-disclaimer message "Authorized Access Only. All activities are monitored and logged."
UI_REMEDIATION: Fireware Web UI -> System -> Logon Disclaimer -> Enable Logon Disclaimer and enter warning text
login_banner_configured.notes: Logon Disclaimer requires users to acknowledge security policies and warning banner before session access is granted. Ref: Fireware Help (Logon Disclaimer).

logging_enabled.summary: Enable system logging and configure remote syslog or WatchGuard Log Server destination.
cli: logging enable
log-server <SYSLOG-IP> syslog
UI_REMEDIATION: Fireware Web UI -> System -> Logging -> Syslog Server -> Add syslog server IP
logging_enabled.notes: Centralized logging ensures audit trail retention. Configure remote syslog server. Ref: Fireware CLI Reference (log-server).

ntp_configured.summary: Enable NTP client and configure at least two redundant time sources.
cli: ntp enable
ntp server <PRIMARY-NTP-IP>
ntp server <SECONDARY-NTP-IP>
UI_REMEDIATION: Fireware Web UI -> System -> NTP -> Enable NTP and add redundant NTP server addresses
ntp_configured.notes: Accurate time synchronization is critical for security event correlation and forensic analysis. Configure redundant NTP servers. Ref: Fireware CLI Reference (ntp).
